outcome: duration of latent phase of labor
duration of active phase of labor
cohort: Nulliparous women with epidural analgesia, comparing obese (BMI ≥30 kg/m(2), n=121) and normal weight (BMI 18.5-25 kg/m(2), n=161) women who delivered at Centro Hospitalar, São João, Porto, Portugal between January 1st and December 31st, 2016
finding: Obese women undergoing labor induction with prostaglandins had a longer latent phase of labor compared to normal weight women, but obesity did not affect the duration of active phase.
mod_finding: Obese women had a significantly higher rate of cesarean delivery (47.1% vs 27.3%), fewer normal vaginal deliveries (28.9% vs 32.9%) and fewer instrumental vaginal deliveries (24.0% vs 39.8%).
